readerTension.whatReaderIsConfusedAbout: Whether a selfie-based scan has a real use beyond a generic skincare quiz.
readerTension.whatReaderIsAnxiousAbout: Being judged, misled into product buying, or treating a serious concern as a cosmetic issue.
readerTension.decisionReaderNeedsToMake: Whether to start a free scan now, use an existing guide, or speak to a dermatologist.

categoryManagerPov.whatToChoose: A scan as a low-pressure way to organize visible signals before adding or changing products.
categoryManagerPov.whatToAvoid: Treating a scan result as a diagnosis, chasing a perfect score, or buying several actives at once.
categoryManagerPov.whereBuyersGoWrong: They ask a tool for certainty when they really need a clearer first question and a calmer routine decision.
categoryManagerPov.whatTheBrandBelieves: Good skincare guidance helps people notice what matters first, then gives them permission to seek professional advice when needed.
tradeoffsThatMatter: personalized starting point versus medical diagnosis
simple routine priorities versus product overload

plannedExamples: A Mumbai commuter sees more shine around the T-zone but does not know whether to change every product; the scan can help prioritize the visible oiliness signal before a routine reset.

A Bengaluru student notices marks and texture after recurring breakouts; the scan can make the visible pattern easier to describe while making clear that painful or persistent changes merit dermatologist guidance.

mistakesToCover: using a scan as a diagnosis
changing an entire routine after one result
taking a selfie in poor light and treating it as definitive

conditions: a rapidly changing, painful, bleeding, or persistent skin concern
a reader seeking diagnosis or prescription treatment

brandPov.statement: MyMirror makes the first skincare decision easier to understand; it does not replace the judgement of a qualified dermatologist.

finalClosingBeforeCta.plannedClosing: You do not need a perfect face or a ten-step routine to begin. Start by seeing what is visible today, then choose one sensible next step.
